text.tspan: They brought Him one (they brought Him one)
Or speak too well; (or speak too well)
Please fix his ear! (Please fix his ear!)
They brought Him one who couldn’t hear (who couldn’t hear)
Or speak too well; please fix his ear. (Please fix his ear!)
The deaf man heard, (the deaf man heard)
The blind man saw; (the blind man saw)
Were filled with awe! (were filled with awe!)
The deaf man heard, the blind man saw; (the blind man saw)
The people all were filled with awe! (were filled with awe!)
Now who could heal (now who could heal)
Such things as these? (such things as these)
Cure all of them (cure all of them)
It’s only God and He was pleased (and He was pleased)
To care for them and set them free! (and set them free!)
